sources.label: USYC product structuring: allowlist, entitlements, and system halt

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Issuer documentation explicitly describes allowlist entitlements and a system halt that can freeze all USYC transactions. The verified Ethereum implementation checks transfer permissions through RolesAuthority. At finalized Solana slot 452213698, Token-2022 USYC retained live freezeAuthority DZ7j2YLDq7847t2HtCWaDQUTpLJ4BinPGsY8w9Aai63y, a non-executable account owned by the documented Teller and Permissions program. The prior inferred Yes verdict is now supported by primary documentation and pinned state.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USYC has issuer-operated Teller paths on native Ethereum and Solana. BSC USYC is a canonical-chain-sourced Cross Chain Teller bridge representation from Ethereum with burn/mint semantics; its direct minter, shared allowance, Entitlements/admin, and token upgrade controls are assessed here rather than in Mint Authority. The route remains issuer-native-burn-mint, with no permissionless validator network evidenced.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review / mint-bridge boundary migration

routes.reviewNote: Official USYC documentation identifies BSC as a BEP20 representation and directs subscription and redemption through the Cross Chain Teller from Ethereum. The BSC token's current mint, admin, and upgrade surfaces are therefore bridge-route controls rather than independent native issuance.

controls.label: USYC BSC Cross Chain Teller representation minter
controls.capDescription: The BSC representation minter had a uint256.max allowance; this is bridge-route mint capacity and not an independent native issuance cap.

routeChecks.rateLimits: At BSC block 116356868, minterAllowance(0xfd78...D002) returned uint256.max; no aggregate or per-call token mint ceiling was evidenced for this representation route.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The BSC Cross Chain Teller representation minter is administered through the BSC Entitlements/RolesAuthority and token-owner surfaces recorded below.

controls.evidence: At BSC block 116356868, minterAllowance(0xfd78...D002) returned uint256.max. The allowance is not decremented by minting and the BSC token has no global supply cap, but the token is an Ethereum-sourced Cross Chain Teller representation.

controls.label: USYC BSC shared secondary EOA representation minter
controls.capDescription: This zero-code EOA had a uint256.max allowance on the BSC representation; the allowance is bridge-route mint capacity and is not independent native issuance.

routeChecks.rateLimits: At BSC block 116356868, the shared EOA's minterAllowance returned uint256.max; the allowance is not decremented by representation minting.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The EOA's BSC representation allowance is separate from the native Ethereum allowance and is scored only under this bridge route.

controls.evidence: At BSC block 116356868, this zero-code EOA had uint256.max minter allowance on the BSC USYC representation. The allowance is not decremented by minting. This is the shared EOA's bridge-route capability, while its Ethereum native allowance remains separately reviewed in Mint Authority.

controls.label: USYC BSC Entitlements/RolesAuthority owner
controls.capDescription: The BSC Entitlements/RolesAuthority owner can modify authority capability assignments and grant or revoke the FundAdmin path that authorizes representation minters.

routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: At BSC block 116356868, this zero-code EOA owned the BSC Entitlements/RolesAuthority and could immediately grant or revoke FundAdmin and related representation-minter permissions.

controls.evidence: At BSC block 116356868, this zero-code EOA owned Entitlements/RolesAuthority 0x6b7d...3692. It could immediately grant or revoke the FundAdmin role and modify authority capability assignments, enabling a new unbounded minter on the BSC representation route.

controls.label: USYC BSC representation token upgrade owner
controls.capDescription: The zero-code BSC token owner can replace the representation token's mint logic immediately through the UUPS onlyOwner upgrade path, with no on-chain delay.
controls.evidence: At BSC block 116356868, this zero-code EOA was token owner. The UUPS implementation's _authorizeUpgrade is onlyOwner, so the account could replace BSC representation mint logic immediately with no on-chain delay. The current implementation still requires minterAllowance and does not give the owner a direct mint path by itself.

controls.label: USYC BSC Cross Chain Teller FundAdmin
controls.capDescription: The shared zero-code FundAdmin can immediately set BSC representation minter allowances to uint256.max; its Ethereum native FundAdmin and minter capability remains separately scored in Mint Authority.

routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: At BSC block 116356868, this zero-code EOA was the current FundAdmin on the BSC Entitlements/RolesAuthority and could immediately set representation-minter allowances.

controls.evidence: Historical BSC block 116356868 review recorded this zero-code EOA as FundAdmin able to set representation-minter allowances. On 2026-10-01 at BSC block 125056474, Entitlements canCall(this account,USYC,setMinterAllowance) returned false, while doesUserHaveRole(this account,255) reverted. A separate block 125056037 read found its representation minter allowance was zero. The current FundAdmin capability is therefore not reconfirmed; no inference from the reverted role read is used to remove the historical adverse control. The native Ethereum FundAdmin capability was independently reconfirmed and remains separately scored.

scopedQuestions.question: Does the BSC Entitlements contract still authorize this historical FundAdmin to set representation-minter allowances through another role or capability path? At block 125056474 canCall returned false and the historical doesUserHaveRole ABI reverted; the old adverse control is retained pending a deployment-specific ABI and capability review.
